_note: Settings of the plan generator (kit/gen/generate_plan.py --config) for the macOS cells of the measurement. Frozen with the pre-registration and not edited afterwards. The same file serves both macOS cells; the cell with live conversion on is generated with kit/gen/recipes.json and the cell with it off with kit/gen/recipes.macos-live-off.json. The key-interval medians span the per-participant mean inter-key intervals of the slowest tenth, all participants and the fastest tenth reported by Dhakal, Feit, Kristensson and Oulasvirta (2018); the other values are design choices explained in the pre-registration.
